stats.text: Since 2020, Lamar Jackson is 11–1 as a starter indoors while wearing an even number.
stats.query:
SELECT qb_id AS subject,
       count(*) AS sample,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE points > opp_points) AS wins,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE points < opp_points) AS losses,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE points = opp_points) AS ties
FROM team_games
WHERE (season BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026)
  AND (true)
  AND (roof IN ('dome', 'closed'))
  AND (qb_jersey % 2 = 0)
GROUP BY qb_id
HAVING count(*) >= 8
ORDER BY qb_id

stats.text: Since 2018, Jameis Winston has thrown 24 interceptions in 12 games at home, while wearing an odd number and outside the division.
stats.query:
SELECT qb_id AS subject,
       count(DISTINCT game_id) AS sample,
       sum(interception) AS total
FROM plays
WHERE (season BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026)
  AND (play_type = 'pass')
  AND (passer_player_id = qb_id)
  AND (is_home)
  AND (qb_jersey % 2 = 1)
  AND (div_game = 0)
GROUP BY qb_id
HAVING count(DISTINCT game_id) >= 8
ORDER BY qb_id

stats.text: The Patriots have thrown no interceptions in 9 games against division rivals when their starting QB wears an odd number since 2020.

conditions.label: when their starting QB wears an odd number

stats.query:
SELECT team AS subject,
       count(DISTINCT game_id) AS sample,
       sum(interception) AS total
FROM plays
WHERE (season BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026)
  AND (play_type = 'pass')
  AND (true)
  AND (div_game = 1)
  AND (qb_jersey % 2 = 1)
GROUP BY team
HAVING count(DISTINCT game_id) >= 8
ORDER BY team

stats.text: Since 2018, Kenny Pickett has thrown just 5 touchdown passes in 15 games in early kickoffs while wearing an even number.
stats.query:
SELECT qb_id AS subject,
       count(DISTINCT game_id) AS sample,
       sum(pass_touchdown) AS total
FROM plays
WHERE (season BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026)
  AND (play_type = 'pass')
  AND (passer_player_id = qb_id)
  AND (gametime < '14:00')
  AND (qb_jersey % 2 = 0)
GROUP BY qb_id
HAVING count(DISTINCT game_id) >= 8
ORDER BY qb_id

stats.text: Since 2005, the Steelers have converted 6 of 8 fourth downs (75%) in early kickoffs in the playoffs.
stats.query:
SELECT team AS subject,
       count(*) AS sample,
       sum(fourth_down_converted) AS hits
FROM plays
WHERE (season BETWEEN 2005 AND 2026)
  AND (down = 4 AND play_type IN ('pass', 'run'))
  AND (true)
  AND (gametime < '14:00')
  AND (game_type <> 'REG')
GROUP BY team
HAVING count(*) >= 8
ORDER BY team

stats.text: Since 1999, the Broncos have converted 7 of 9 fourth downs (77.8%) on Saturdays in sub-freezing games.
stats.query:
SELECT team AS subject,
       count(*) AS sample,
       sum(fourth_down_converted) AS hits
FROM plays
WHERE (season BETWEEN 1999 AND 2026)
  AND (down = 4 AND play_type IN ('pass', 'run'))
  AND (true)
  AND (weekday = 'Saturday')
  AND (temp <= 32)
GROUP BY team
HAVING count(*) >= 8
ORDER BY team
